Covers central business district and federal enclave.

Covers central business district and federal enclave. Selected buildings shown pictorially. Shows radial distances from Washington Monument. Also shows Tourmobile shuttle routes. "*GPO:2005--310-394/00407. Reprint 2005." Title from panel. Includes text and tourist directory. Text, city chronology, facsims. of L'Enfant and McMillan plans, and col. ill. on verso. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. DCP
